input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.
It looks like my messaging app is currently unable to send MMS messages. What should I try next to get this working again?

I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that I have poor signal strength and I’m currently connected to a 2G network. Mobile data is enabled.

What should I do next?
I changed my network mode to "4G/5G preferred," and now my phone shows excellent signal strength on 5G. However, I still can’t send MMS messages. What should I try next?
I checked my APN settings, and the MMSC URL is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Is this correct, or should I try resetting the APN settings to default?
I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my phone. What should I try next to fix the MMS issue?
I checked my messaging app’s permissions, and it only has permission for phone access. It doesn’t have permissions for storage or SMS/MMS. Should I grant those permissions to the app?

I’ve granted the messaging app permissions for both storage and SMS/MMS. I just checked, and now I’m able to send MMS messages again! Thank you for your help—everything seems to be working properly now.
Thank you so much for your help and patience! I appreciate the step-by-step guidance. I’ll reach out if I have any more questions in the future. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###
